representation: B: separately derived coefficient blocks, reversed BS:AR cut, column Gram and SVD
source: Independent same-agent pass from the rendered arXiv:2608.28897v1 p.2 and p.7 and quant-ph/0202044v3 p.8; no read of A data or result in B implementation
domain: All xij are real nonnegative with sum xij**2=1; occupied auxiliary outcome vectors are normalized and mutually orthogonal.
logical_order: B-side outcome first; full physical order B,A and environmental order S,R.
block_bound: Let K_ij=xij*Phi_ij with Frobenius norm(Phi_ij)=1. For a block vector w=(w0,w1), norm((K w)_i)<=sum_j xij*norm(wj). Squaring and summing gives norm(K w)<=norm(M)*norm(w). Hence largest Schmidt weight<=norm(M)**2.
basis_map: K_B=transpose(K_A), not adjoint, since pure-ket coefficients are transposed by swapping the two sides. G_A=M*M^T, G_B=M^T*M are different matrices with identical nonzero spectra. Physical index B,A -> A,B uses [0,2,1,3].
two_copy_map: Logical index i=2*i1+i2 and j=2*j1+j2. K_A[(i,r),(j,s)] maps to K_B[(j,s),(i,r)]. Source order A1 B1 A2 B2 is permuted to A1 A2 B1 B2 by swapping axes 1 and 2; environment labels follow the same grouping.
entropy_convention: Base 2; Schmidt weights are singular values squared, never singular values themselves.
independence_limit: Both passes were by this one worker. Same primary papers, mathematical problem and benchmark labels were shared; no fresh referee or separate agent is claimed.
